about: Where Chris’s skills get their XP in Phase 4 (CONTRACT-PHASE4.md §4.21; PLAN.md §4; COMBAT.md §5.2, §6). Every other skill shows level 1 and a line on where it comes from (content/skills.json). Warding gets the same amount as the Road XP of every fight, bow and stitch, so it has no row here. spell-circle is per circle of the spell cast; wild-stitch-depth is per depth of the stitched rift, on top of wild-stitch. perDay counts how many times a day the source pays.

sources.text: A crew session watched to the end
A building designed for the first time
A spell in a fight, for each of its circles
A new chunk of the wilds charted
A lantern lit for the first time
Each depth of a wild rift stitched
